sid.reason: T8110 DART instance field captured in 13.5 detail (line 'sid = 64424509440' on dart-ane j180d); the T8122 detail ADT was summarized not full-parsed (the receipt script condenses), so the T8122 sid byte string is not in the lab notebook. The T8110 family sid value for ANE (sids 40961 in T8103/T6000; the T8110/T6020/T6021/T6030 family uses a different encoding per the T6020 detail 0x28e084000..0x28e084033 dapf-instance-0 byte range that is identical in shape to T6020/T6021) is consistent across the T8110 family. Field is present in ADT but the receipt script did not preserve it. Re-extract the T8122 ADT detail with the same script used for j180d to obtain the sid byte string. Not verified.

compatible.reason: INFERENCE, not measured: no ANE mailbox node exists in the ADT summary (S1) or in the kernel tree (S4). Every other T8122 ASC mailbox in S4 (smc, aop, mtp, ans; t8122.dtsi:833-1069) is apple,t8122-asc-mailbox + apple,asc-mailbox-v4, so that class is expected. Detail: receipts/2026-10-03-ane-h15.

reg.reason: INFERENCE, not measured: no ADT window is named as the mailbox. On T6021 the ANE mailbox is the ASC wrapper + 0x8000 (engine + 0x1408000) and engine + 0x1050000 is RVBAR (ane/t6021/ane_t6021.h:104-147); every T8122 ASC mailbox in S4 is its ASC base + 0x8000. ANE reg[0] (S1) is engine + 0x1400000, so the expected mailbox is 0x311408000+0x4000, inside reg[0]. The earlier value 0x311050000 (reg[1], the T6021 RVBAR offset) had no source for the mailbox role.

interrupts.reason: INFERENCE, not measured: the ADT ane node lists 507 506 509 508 524 (S1, kept in ane.interrupts). The first four are the block 506..509; the last is the DART IRQ 525 minus one, as T6021's single ANE IRQ 884 is DART 885 minus one. Each T8122 ASC mailbox in S4 takes four consecutive lines named send-empty, send-not-empty, recv-empty, recv-not-empty in that order, which would make 506..509 the ANE mailbox in that order. The ADT does not name the roles. The earlier list 506, 508, 509, 507, 524 had no source.

driver_family.reason: INFERENCE (b0 decision, receipts/2026-10-03-ane-h15): ane_t6021-like at the ASC layer, no new ASC-IOP client. S1 gives reg[0] = engine + 0x1400000 (the ASC wrapper whose CPU_CONTROL ane_t6021 sets at +0x44), reg[1] = engine + 0x1050000 (the T6021 RVBAR offset) and the DART at engine + 0x1800000 with the T6021 four-window shape; S4 uses apple,asc-mailbox-v4 for every M3 ASC mailbox. Not measured: whether the firmware that iBoot preloads on an M3 Linux boot sends RTKit HELLO. The T6021 13.5 image never did, and its working path is the legacy ChMan ring, which is tied to that image.
